label: A root without represented limitation and finite reach give GOD_4 simplicity (inference)
rule: Identify the concrete root by finite grounding reach and exclude the composition horn on the same witness
meaning: Take the actual root n at w from the existential bundle and use the first disjunct of HasLimitingPrinciple to derive its noncomposition. For each bearer g satisfying IsGod, the open reach premise supplies a finite path to n in the same profile at w. The actual-root condition excludes an incoming last edge, so namedRootOfReach gives g = n. Transport noncomposition with the same Composite predicate. Only actual roothood and absence of the composition horn are used from the existing bundle. The remaining horns and accessible-world existence are retained as conjuncts of the existing support option. This universal conclusion makes no existence assertion.
